comment: Dr. Hoyt is super sweet and fun! Her classes are a really nice combination of group work/discussions and lectures. Tests can be a little hard, but you can earn half the credit you lost back.

I had Dr. Hoyt for Leadership 102, and she was amazing. Her passion for social psychology is contagious. The weekly homework assignments were short reading reflections which she always offered almost immediate feedback on. The papers and exams were pretty straightforward and Dr. Hoyt would always offer help finding research for the papers.

Dr. Hoyt was great in this course. Readings are important but the write ups about them are easy As. Lecture almost every day but broke out into smaller group discussions. Very heavily concentrated in psychology more so than political science and economics. Would recommend taking her section if you need to take the class!

She's super nice but suuuch a picky grader. will take points off for lots of dumb stuff. 75% of your grade is made up of 3 assignments: a paper, a midterm, and a final. so its hard to get an A bc she grades these things harshly and its such a huge % of ur grade. wouldn't recommend her tbh

Dr. Hoyt is an extremely smart and energetic professor, but she does not teach Leadership and the Social Sciences well. The class only covers social psychology, and the tests are extremely hard as she asks about nitpicky points from the readings and class. The class ends with a group project, final paper, and a final exam. DO NOT TAKE!
She's a nice, smart person and you will learn a lot of important subject matter in her FYS, but it's not that easy to get an A.
She is awesome but her tests are really hard. Get ready for intensive work.

Hoyt is such a friendly professor! The actual class discussion are interesting and easy to participate in (which participation is everything for her). The tests are extremely hard but she grades papers fairly.  She is bubbly and for a 9am class had more energy than all the students put together!

Had her for Diversity and Leadership. She knows her stuff, is very organized and posts her powerpoint online. However its important to take notes as most of it is just pictures. Her tests are very difficult. They are very precise and nit picky. Make sure you write everything you can on your "cheat sheet" she lets you use for your test.
